findings.source: StakeManager.sol:692 while (context.validatorIndex < context.totalValidators && context.validators[context.validatorIndex] != signer) { context.unsignedValidators[context.numUnsignedValidators] = signerToValidator[context.validators[context.validatorIndex]]; context.numUnsignedValidators++; context.validatorIndex++; }
findings.issue: The loop condition is precomputed into a boolean before the loop and recomputed at the end of the body (rotated, P3), and the memory struct's fields (validatorIndex, totalValidators, validators, numUnsignedValidators, unsignedValidators) are raw mem[160], mem[256], mem[224], mem[128], mem[192] (P14/P18), so the loop reads as 'while _361'.
findings.rule: When a boolean is computed identically before the loop and at the end of its body and is only the loop test, inline it into the while condition (short-circuit 'a and b'); name constant memory words used only as fields of one allocation as that struct's members.
